fusions.name: Pulled Thread
fusions.desc: Gnaws a thread loose from the target, dealing 4 damage and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Moth-Eaten Wards
fusions.desc: The swarm chews through every woven protection in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Thrown Dust Sheet
fusions.desc: Throws a sheet over you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the sheet comes off the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Lined Burrow
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
